text:
Omar H.: hi team, quick request — i observe daily Dhuhr prayer around 12:30–12:50pm. my manager started a standing 12:30 team sync that overlaps. can we get an accommodation for a 25m prayer break + permission to step out?
Priya S.: +1. Omar, we should flag to people ops so they can note it in accommodations. manager probably unaware.
Ben K.: Omar sorry — i scheduled that to catch EMEA handoff. didn't realize about Dhuhr. happy to move the sync. suggestions?
Omar H.: thanks Ben. if the sync moves to 12:00 or 1:00 it's fine. if not, i'd ask for permission to drop for 25m and check notes after. also would like a quiet space option when in-office.
Carla (People Ops): thanks for raising this, Omar. we can document a religious accommodation. please use the confidential accommodations form (https://intranet.redwood/hr/accom-form) or DM me a brief note. we don't need medical docs for religious requests.
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2027-201 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Ben K.: i can move the standing sync to 1:00pm M/W/F and keep T/Th at 11:30 for EMEA. will update the calendar and add a note that Omar may step out when needed.
Omar H.: that works — thank you. for on-site, is there a quiet room booking process? sometimes the cafe is noisy.
Carla (People Ops): yes — Facilities has a short-term booking form. i'll add a reserved "Quiet Prayer" slot for 12:15-12:45 on days Omar requests it and share the link. we'll document the accommodation with a 90-day review.
Priya S.: appreciate the quick pivot. reminder to the team: keep calendar notes visible so async catch-up is easy.
Ben K.: updated calendar invites and left a brief note (no health/religious specifics) about flexibility for brief breaks. Omar let me know if it still doesn't work.
Omar H.: uploaded a one-line request via the form and DM'd Carla the receipt. thanks everyone. :pray:
Carla (People Ops): got it. AC-2027-201 updated. will follow up in 30 days to check if the arrangement is working or if we need permanent schedule changes. if others need similar support, DM the channel or submit the form.
peopleops-bot: AC-2027-201 status changed: intake -> documented.
Omar H.: feeling relieved — thank you all.
Ben K.: glad we could sort quickly.
Carla (People Ops): filing note in the accommodations ledger and notifying Facilities. all messages here are confidential; please avoid sharing details outside required parties. :lock:
